start_date.description: First day of the event as YYYY-MM-DD, or null if not stated.

start_time.description: Local start time as 24-hour HH:MM, or null if not stated.

city.description: City where attendees physically gather, in English spelling; null for online-only events.

is_free.description: True if attendance is free, false if a price is charged, null if not mentioned.

price_amount.description: Standard full price of one regular ticket; null if free or not stated.

price_currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of price_amount; null when price_amount is null.

topic.description: Main subject area of the event.
